places.name: Zona Colonial (UNESCO World Heritage)
places.ai_summary: Zona Colonial is the historic heart of Santo Domingo, featuring cobblestone streets, colonial buildings, and vibrant cultural landmarks.
places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the rich history of the area.
places.address: Zona Colonial, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic

places.name: Catedral Primada de América
places.ai_summary: The Catedral Primada de América is the first cathedral built in the Americas, showcasing Gothic and Renaissance architectural styles.
places.place_tip: Admire the intricate stained glass windows and historic artifacts.
places.address: Catedral Primada de América, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic

places.ai_summary: The Alcázar de Colón is a historic palace that once served as the residence of Diego Columbus, showcasing colonial artifacts.
places.place_tip: Explore the museum to learn about the colonial history of the Americas.
places.address: Alcázar de Colón, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic

places.name: Plaza de España
places.ai_summary: Plaza de España is a historic square in the Colonial Zone, surrounded by important landmarks and offering a glimpse into the colonial past.

opening_hours.notes: A popular spot for photos and relaxation.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby cafes for a taste of local cuisine.

places.ai_summary: Fortaleza Ozama is a historic fortress that once protected the city from pirates and invaders, offering panoramic views of the Caribbean Sea.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the views from the top of the fortress.

places.ai_summary: Museo de las Casas Reales is a museum dedicated to the history of the Dominican Republic, located in a former royal house.
places.place_tip: Check out the Taino art and colonial artifacts.
places.address: Museo de las Casas Reales, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic

places.name: Parque Colón & Christopher Columbus Statue
places.ai_summary: Parque Colón is a central park in the Colonial Zone, featuring a statue of Christopher Columbus and surrounded by historic buildings.
places.place_tip: Visit the nearby shops and cafes.
places.address: Parque Colón, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic

places.ai_summary: Calle El Conde is a famous pedestrian street in the Colonial Zone, known for its shops, cafes, and vibrant atmosphere.
places.place_tip: Try the local street food and visit the artisan shops.
places.address: Calle El Conde, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic

places.name: Malecon Seaside Drive
places.ai_summary: Malecon Seaside Drive is a popular waterfront boulevard in Santo Domingo, ideal for a scenic drive or stroll by the Caribbean Sea.

opening_hours.notes: Popular for morning jogs and evening walks.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the local seafood at the restaurants along the Malecon.
places.address: Malecon, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic

places.name: National Pantheon of the Dominican Republic
places.ai_summary: The National Pantheon is a mausoleum in Santo Domingo, containing the remains of many important figures in Dominican history.
places.place_tip: Attend the changing of the guard ceremony if possible.
places.address: National Pantheon, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic

places.name: Palacio Nacional
places.ai_summary: The Palacio Nacional is the presidential palace of the Dominican Republic, an important government building with impressive architecture.
places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the history and functions of the palace.
places.address: Palacio Nacional, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic

places.name: National Botanical Garden
places.ai_summary: The National Botanical Garden is a large park in Santo Domingo, featuring a wide variety of plants, trees, and themed gardens.
places.place_tip: Visit the orchid garden and the tropical rainforest exhibit.

places.name: Mirador Sur Park

places.place_tip: Bring water and sunscreen if visiting during the day.
places.address: Mirador Sur Park, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic
